newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takara Shuzo falls on possible rise in liquor tax.
newsitem.headline: Takara Shuzo falls on possible rise in liquor tax.

text.p: Shares in Takara Shuzo Co Ltd fell on Wednesday, depressed by Japanese media reports that the Finance Ministry is likely to raise taxes on domestic liquor following a World Trade Organisation (WTO) ruling that its tax system treats foreign liquor unfairly.
The share price was down 19 yen at 965 yen at 0542 GMT, after briefly dipping to 963 yen. Volume was 517,000 shares.

A senior ministry official later said that the ministry will decide by the end of December what steps can be taken to revise the tax system in the next fiscal year in order to abide by the WTO ruling.
